mapper.sql: id, record_no, target_type, season_id, match_id, team_id, event_team_id, player_id, member_id, discipline_type, penalty_code, title, reason_text, penalty_content, match_suspension_count, match_suspension_remaining, point_deduction, discipline_status, record_status, effective_start_time, effective_end_time, decision_by, decision_time, approved_by, approved_time, revoked_by, revoked_time, revoke_reason, source_type, idempotency_key, announcement_id, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.insert: insert into basket_discipline_record (record_no, target_type, season_id, match_id, team_id, event_team_id, player_id, member_id, discipline_type, penalty_code, title, reason_text, penalty_content, match_suspension_count, match_suspension_remaining, point_deduction, discipline_status, record_status, effective_start_time, effective_end_time, decision_by, decision_time, source_type, idempotency_key, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{recordNo}, #{targetType}, #{seasonId}, #{matchId}, #{teamId}, #{eventTeamId}, #{playerId}, #{memberId}, #{disciplineType}, #{penaltyCode}, #{title}, #{reasonText}, #{penaltyContent}, #{matchSuspensionCount}, #{matchSuspensionRemaining}, #{pointDeduction}, #{disciplineStatus}, #{recordStatus}, #{effectiveStartTime}, #{effectiveEndTime}, #{decisionBy}, #{decisionTime}, #{sourceType}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select from basket_discipline_record where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select d.id, d.record_no as recordNo, d.target_type as targetType, d.season_id as seasonId, s.season_name as seasonName, d.match_id as matchId, d.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, d.event_team_id as eventTeamId, d.player_id as playerId, p.player_no as playerNo, d.member_id as memberId, d.discipline_type as disciplineType, d.penalty_code as penaltyCode, d.title, d.reason_text as reasonText, d.penalty_content as penaltyContent, d.match_suspension_count as matchSuspensionCount, d.match_suspension_remaining as matchSuspensionRemaining, d.point_deduction as pointDeduction, d.discipline_status as disciplineStatus, d.record_status as recordStatus, d.effective_start_time as effectiveStartTime, d.effective_end_time as effectiveEndTime, d.decision_by as decisionBy, d.decision_time as decisionTime, d.approved_by as approvedBy, d.approved_time as approvedTime, d.revoked_by as revokedBy, d.revoked_time as revokedTime, d.revoke_reason as revokeReason, d.source_type as sourceType, d.idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, d.announcement_id as announcementId, d.create_time as createTime, d.update_time as updateTime, d.is_delete as isDelete from basket_discipline_record d left join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = d.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = d.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = d.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 where d.id = #{id} and d.is_delete = 0
select count(*) from basket_discipline_record where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update:
update basket_discipline_record set record_status = #{toStatus}, discipline_status = #{disciplineStatus}, update_time = now()
, approved_by = #{operatorId}, approved_time = now()
, revoked_by = #{operatorId}, revoked_time = now(), revoke_reason = #{revokeReason}
where id = #{id} and record_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0
update basket_discipline_record set match_suspension_remaining = #{remaining}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select from basket_discipline_record where season_id = #{seasonId} and member_id = #{memberId} and record_status = 'ACTIVE' and discipline_status = 1 and is_delete = 0 and match_suspension_remaining > 0 and effective_start_time <= #{now} and (effective_end_time is null or effective_end_time >= #{now}) order by decision_time asc, id asc limit 1
